currently.title: Currently
currently.paragraph1: As a Product Engineer at Prizmstack, I'm building FIJI: a valuation platform for real estate businesses. I work on the migration from no-code to Next.js and build the value simulation engine.
currently.stack: Current stack: TypeScript, Next.js, PostgreSQL, Supabase.
currently.paragraph2: In parallel, I teach Digital Techniques at IPSAJ to Electronics students. Combining production code with teaching pushes me to think about how people learn to build software.
currently.paragraph3: Looking for opportunities in LATAM (remote preferred) in healthtech, fintech or startups with interesting products.

blog.title: Blog
blog.description: Thoughts on development, learning and life.

intro.paragraph1: I'm a Product Engineer based in Argentina. I work at the intersection of engineering, product and business: building tools people use, defining priorities based on impact, and translating strategic ambiguity into executable plans.
intro.paragraph2: I'm a bioengineer from ITBA, a detail that shapes how I approach problems: with quantitative rigor, metrics-focused thinking, and a systems mindset. I started as a frontend developer 4 years ago and grew into roles where product and business matter as much as code.
intro.paragraph3: My mid-term goal is to lead product teams where technical and strategic decisions are made together. To get there, I'm still building today: learning how to design actionable metrics, how to prioritize with criteria, and how to execute with speed without losing quality.

tools.intro: I primarily work with Next.js, TypeScript and PostgreSQL on product projects. Experienced with payment integrations (Stripe, Mercado Pago, PayPal) and migrating stacks from no-code to code (Bubble → Next.js).

frontend.label: Frontend
frontend.items: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, MaterialUI

languages.englishDescription: I've worked with US-based teams since 2023 (Tumo at Techstars W24 NY, currently Prizmstack in California). My English is functional for technical work, written communication and async collaboration. I continue actively improving conversational fluency.

lookingFor.intro: Opportunities in LATAM (remote preferred, open to hybrid) at companies with interesting products. I'm especially motivated by:
lookingFor.item1: Healthtech and fintech: industries where technical complexity intersects with real impact on people's lives.
lookingFor.item2: Growing startups: places where product, engineering and business are discussed at the same table.
lookingFor.item3: Established companies with strong product culture: where process rigor doesn't kill iteration speed.
lookingFor.outro: I'm open to other niches if the team and the problem are interesting.
